newsitem.title: USA: Wellco wins military shoe contract.
newsitem.headline: Wellco wins military shoe contract.

text.p: Wellco Enterprises Inc said Wednesday it had won a contract from the Defense Personnel Support Center to supply the U.S. armed forces with its intermediate cold/wet boot.
The contract has a total value in the first year of $6.4-$9.6 million, it said.
Wellco said it is the first time it has received a contract for the boot. It is required to deliver between 80,002 and 121,600 pairs over a one-year period.
It said the contract gives DPSC two options, each providing for the purchase of between 44,000 and 66,000 pairs of the boot, with a total contract value for each option of $3.6-$5.4 million.
Wellco said the boot is designed for wear in cold and damp climates and uses the Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co welt soling process.
The company has subcontracted certain manufacturing operations to Rocky Shoes & Boots of Nelsonville, Ohio, it said.
Wellco said it expects first shipments under the DPSC contract to come in its quarter ending June 28, 1997.
It said it is waiting for DPSC to announce combat boot contract awards covering the next five years. It expects the awards to be made within a few weeks.
